main.description: Parse a resume into a draft for review. Served by the AppView, never the PDS: repo blobs are public. The file is held in memory only and dropped once parsed. Requires service auth from the uploader's PDS (lxm = this NSID).

input.description: A PDF or DOCX, at most 5 MB. The type is detected from the bytes.

errors.name: NoTextFound
errors.description: Scanned or image-only documents are not supported.
